answer: Our network mandates cryptographic attestation chains where each agent verifies identity through zero-knowledge proofs. To broadcast an actionable signal, nodes deposit stake governed by superlinear scaling: creating a duplicate identity demands an exponential capital exhaustion curve, raising costs to O(2^n). Like evaluating a complex sonnet, verification requires high-dimensional proof computation, ensuring identity legitimacy remains crystal clear while rendering Sybil swarms economically unviable.
